qa.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages that come along with changing jobs?
qa.a: Well, you need to get to grips with the whole new work environment and the policies that come with that, which there's no escaping, badly. But you get the chance to meet people and make new friends, which is nice for the reasons that we talked about earlier when we talked about young people.

qa.q: Are big companies better than small companies?
qa.a: I have no idea, really. I mean, from a certain perspective, big businesses are relatively more stable and have more opportunities for progression and developments and possibly allow for larger salaries just because they're likely to generate more income in general.
